query: What concrete pilot success thresholds and stop/go decision rules should we set (e.g., X% reduction in mean time to remediate for critical vulns) and how will we measure statistical confidence?

response.query: What concrete pilot success thresholds and stop/go decision rules should we set (e.g., X% reduction in mean time to remediate for critical vulns) and how will we measure statistical confidence?
response.answer: Set pilot success thresholds at 30% reduction in mean time to remediate critical vulnerabilities; measure statistical confidence with a 95% confidence interval.
